To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed approach can be used for the development of a mobile application that uses a personal trusted device as a communication channel for the mobile devices in the same environment.
the personal trusted device is an appropriate solution for the peer-to-peer communications in a mobile environment and the prototype is a good proof-of-concept for this approach.
a peer-to-peer communication environment can be built on top of personal trusted device concept.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1.
the design of a peer-to-peer communication approach that is able to adapt to the changes in a mobile environment and to the needs of different applications.
the design of the peer-to-peer mobile environment and the implementation of a prototype.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented peer-to-peer communication approach is a promising one.
the presented approach provides a solid foundation for a mobile environment in which the communication is based on peer-to-peer communication.
the presented approach is a good starting point to develop a peer-to-peer environment in mobile computing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed and implemented a prototype of a personal trusted device that can be used in a mobile environment for different purposes.
the approach is promising and the prototype is functional.
the presented architecture provides the basis for a new approach to the peer to peer communication in mobile environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a peer-to-peer communication approach is possible in a mobile environment.
a mobile device can be used to collect information from its neighborhood and use this information for different purposes.
the personal trusted device concept can be used as a building block in the design of mobile applications that need to be aware of the user environment.
